insight: Founder KJ Dhaliwal earlier sold dating app Dil Mil for $50M; raised a $35M Series A from CRV and Kleiner Perkins in Feb 2026.
name: Lotus Health
tagline: Free AI-powered primary care, with every diagnosis and prescription reviewed by real physicians.
description: Lotus Health is a consumer primary-care app whose AI conducts patient consultations and drafts diagnoses, prescriptions, lab orders, and referrals, with board-certified physicians reviewing each before it's finalized. Care is free to patients, licensed across all 50 US states, and available 24/7 in dozens of languages; urgent cases or anything needing a physical exam are routed to in-person care.
edge: Goes beyond AI symptom-checkers to deliver actual care — diagnoses, prescriptions, and labs reviewed by board-certified physicians — at no cost.
pros: Free care: no insurance or fees
Sends prescriptions & labs at no cost
cons: Not for emergencies or physical exams

references.title: Lotus Health nabs $35M for AI doctor that sees patients for free
